categories.name: Release A
categories.description: Represents the standard discharge pathway for patients treated within guideline windows. Advances the softgoal Avoid post-discharge deterioration and is measured against the Post-discharge ER return indicator.
categories.rationale: Mapped 1:1 to the declared alternative Release A (id=17) as observed in multiple variants (e.g. V0008, V0070).

categories.name: Release B
categories.description: Represents an alternative discharge pathway following extended monitoring. Advances the softgoal Avoid post-discharge deterioration and is measured against the Post-discharge ER return indicator.
categories.rationale: Mapped 1:1 to the declared alternative Release B (id=18) as observed in variant V0068 and V0145.
